name: @olai/server
//main: src/serve.ts, not src/main.ts: main.ts ends in a top-level run that starts the server and installs signal handlers, so a resolver honouring `main` over `exports` would boot a listener on import. The binary is reached as a script path (default.nix, the justfile), never as a module.
//dependencies: The composition root: it is the only package allowed to know about all of the others, and the direction is strictly downward (docs/architecture.md). @olai/web is deliberately absent — the server serves a built bundle it is handed, it does not import the client.
//acp: @agentclientprotocol/sdk is the official ACP client, and `zod` is beside it because the SDK declares it a PEER dependency and imports it at runtime to validate protocol payloads. That is the one place zod re-enters a tree the rewrite took it out of, and it is the SDK's validator rather than ours: nothing in olai imports zod, and the format still has exactly one validator (Effect Schema, in @olai/format).
